name: Covered ovoid jar (guan)
dimensions: with cover: H. 24.2 x Diam. 20.5 cm (9 1/2 x 8 1/16 in.)
summary: Covered ovoid jar with short, flared neck, the cover with small lotus-bud shaped knob; off-white stoneware with clear glaze over white slip ground. From northern China, probably from Hebei or Henan province.
